title: CommonsDecisionRecord
description: The durable, externally-observable audit record of a mediated decision: what was asked, what was decided (or that it was escalated), and what happened when it was applied. Produced by the apply-decision feature; consumed by the observer/ledger.

operations.description: Append a commons:decision:record entry to the decision stream

record_id.description: Stable identifier for this ledger record (uuid).

verdict_id.description: The commons:decision:verdict applied; null when the outcome was escalated.

verdict.description: The embedded verdict snapshot (commons:decision:verdict), or null when escalated.

escalation.description: The embedded escalation snapshot (commons:decision:escalation), or null when applied.

disposition.description: Terminal outcome: delivered to the worker, escalated to a human, or delivery failed.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key derived from request+verdict; a repeated key MUST NOT re-apply.

error.description: Failure detail when disposition=application_failed; null otherwise. Never silently swallowed.
